metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods made by anderson-spider.

plugins.name: antigravity
plugins.description: Ask Google's Antigravity CLI (agy) for a second opinion or a review of the branch's changes from another model family, read-only, or an image, and save the result locally.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Ask Codex for a second opinion, a review of the branch's changes or requested images and, on macOS, control native Mac apps through Codex computer use; save results locally.

plugins.name: file-explorer
plugins.description: File tree pane that follows Claude's reads, edits and searches, with git status, search, preview and path references

plugins.name: gchat
plugins.description: Skills that read, summarize and reply in Google Chat, and post GitLab merge request review requests to a space, through Claude in Chrome in the main agent, sending only a text and recipient you explicitly approved.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: A skill for GitHub work with the gh CLI in the main agent: pull requests, pending reviews, Actions runs and workflow logs, issues and comments.

plugins.name: gitlab
plugins.description: Work on GitLab merge requests and pipelines of the current repository, picking the host and token from its git remote, or from a host you name.

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: See images in the terminal: thumbnails of what you paste above the prompt, and each image Claude reads drawn under its row in the transcript

plugins.name: secrets
plugins.description: Claude asks you for a token or password in a card and gets a private file it can use inside a command but not read, while a fence and a scrubber keep the value out of the conversation

plugins.name: session-hud
plugins.description: A card above the prompt: model, the repository, folder and branch, context and cache; the five-hour and seven-day limits with their pace; the running subagents with their type, model and effort, and the tokens they used; what the last turn sent and added, edits and errors; when turned on, next steps to tick and put in the prompt; and /session-hud-panel, a pane with every agent the session ran and the last 15 minutes.

plugins.name: sonarqube
plugins.description: Diagnose SonarQube 9.x analyses (quality gate, measures, issues, rules, hotspots, branches and pull requests) through its read-only Web API, using the url and token plugin options or the SPIDER_PLUGIN_OPTION_SONARQUBE_*, SONARQUBE_* or SONAR_* environment variables.

plugins.name: subagent-effort
plugins.description: Sets the reasoning effort of every native subagent call from Jev's rating of its task, leaving the model as it was, and keeps local records to compare efforts.

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Read or change your tailnet through the Tailscale API using the apiKey plugin option.

plugins.name: verification-planning
plugins.description: A skill that plans, before non-trivial coding work, the project-specific evidence that will establish or refute the change, and closes that path after implementation.
